description: This file implements an authentication service with methods for user signup and login, handling JWT token creation and password verification.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides authentication functionalities including signup and login, managing user credentials, and issuing JWT tokens.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the AuthService with a UsersRepository instance.

methods.name: dict signup(self, name: str, email: str, password: str, role: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user if the email is not already registered, then generates an access token.

methods.name: dict login(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, then issues a JWT token upon success.

ctags.pattern: /^    def login(self, email: str, password: str) -> dict:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^    def signup(self, name: str, email: str, password: str, role: str) -> dict:$/
ctags.signature: (self, name: str, email: str, password: str, role: str)
